integrity.main_claim: Exact phase formula and full Minkowski-center fiber of symmetric two-base Cayley prismatoids.
integrity.verification: Analytical proof with exact-rational finite sanity checks.

scientific_limitations: Requires two full-dimensional individually centrally symmetric bases, after affine alignment of symmetry centers.
The arbitrary-body center fiber is described by all support-direction inequalities; only orthotope fibers have an explicit coordinate-product dimension formula.
Independent mathematical validation and exhaustive historical bibliography have not been performed.
title: Two-support-ratio asymmetry law for symmetric Cayley prismatoids
